title: Shared costs
description: One ledger: who paid, who benefits and who owes whom. Each currency has its own balance, with no conversion.
closedNotice: The occasion is closed. The ledger is read-only.

transfers.one: One payment to make to settle up.
transfers.few: {count} payments to make to settle up.
transfers.other: {count} payments to make to settle up.

settlement.title: Who owes whom
settlement.settledBody: All balances are zero. When a new cost appears, you will see it here.
settlement.sumNote: The balances always add up to zero.

participants.title: Participants
participants.name: Name
participants.nameHint: As you want it to appear in the ledger.
participants.noMembers: Every team member is already a participant.
participants.noHouseholds: There are no more households to add.
participants.emptyTitle: First add the people who share the costs
participants.emptyBody: They can be people on the team, invited households or anyone else, with a name you type.

entries.title: Entries
entries.needTwo: Add at least two participants to be able to split a cost.
entries.emptyBody: Add the first cost: who paid and who it is split between.
entries.sharesHint: Enter how many shares each person has (0 = not taking part). For example 2 for a couple, 1 for one person.
entries.exactHint: Enter each person's amount. Together they must add up exactly to the total.
entries.voidIntro: An entry is a fact: it is not deleted or edited. Voiding takes it out of the balances and keeps the reason.

own.title: Your balance in the shared costs

export.title: Shared costs (CSV)
export.description: Every entry with its split, and the balances per currency.

errors.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero, for example 1,250 or 1250.50.
errors.noBeneficiaries: Choose at least one person who benefits.
errors.duplicateBeneficiary: The same person appears twice in the split.
errors.badShares: Shares must be whole numbers, with at least one above zero.
errors.badExact: Amounts must be zero or more.
errors.exactShort: The amounts add up to {entered}, {difference} less than the total of {total}. Add {difference} more.
errors.exactOver: The amounts add up to {entered}, {difference} more than the total of {total}. Take off {difference}.
errors.participantMissing: The chosen participant no longer exists. Choose another.
errors.participantExists: You already have a participant with this name.
errors.participantInUse: The participant appears in entries and cannot be removed.
errors.tooManyParticipants: You can have at most {limit} participants.
errors.sameParticipant: The person paying and the person receiving must be different people.
